items.title: The w-test prediction, in memo F's terms

declared.prediction: on the free side (light C >= W, dark C <= W), r = (T25^-1(y25) - C) / (T50^-1(y50) - C) = w(0.25) / w(0.5) = 0.5
declared.basis: memo F: between 0.25 and 0.5 no input that sets C or W moves on the support shapes (s = 44, 64, 96); Normal reads exactly 0.25 and 0.5; lambda (0.9 -> 0.7875) does not enter the free side; the face fill and the dark cap move and are T, inverted natively at each position from that position's greys
declared.liftedSide: read and reported, never gated: the declared lambda25 is 0.7875 in both schemes, against W42's fitted lambda50 scaled by 0.875 or shifted by -0.1125
declared.refutes: a FAIL refutes the composite's slider coupling on the free side; either verdict redirects the next structure wave and lands nothing (clause 8, Decision Log 4)

items.title: The w-test: statistic, support, resolution and verdict

declared.statistic: per supported free-side region and channel, r = (T25^-1(y25) - C) / (T50^-1(y50) - C), averaged over channels; y the region median of the plurality frame (three runs at 0.25, W42's seven at 0.5); T_x native per channel and stratum through the probe's own greys at x (W42's at 0.5); C the backdrop's declared level

support.rule: W42 region populations on the free level (light the brighter, dark the darker), per pixel |C - level| <= 0.5 code and |W - C| >= 24 codes under LT's maps for every k in [1.4, 2.5]; >= 12 px; |M50 - C| >= 12 codes; predicted dr <= 0.10; X21 censoring (>= 250 or <= 5) excludes at 0.5 and makes a 0.25 statistic UNMEASURED; in dark at s >= 96 an inverted M above 208 excluded
support.note: mostly t = 0 (capsule, rrect-64); the pitch-16 checkers drop out everywhere
support.liftedReported: lifted-side regions are listed beside the free ones (reported, never gated)

declared.resolution: dr = (dM25 + |r| dM50) / |M50 - C|, dM = (0.5 median quantisation + 0.5 ordinate quantisation + the T table's interpolation error from the three nearest ordinates' curvature) / T's slope
declared.verdict: per endpoint: PASS iff |r - 0.5| <= dr on every supported, measured region (at least one); FAIL otherwise, with the measured r; no region measured is UNMEASURED
declared.prediction: wtest/prediction.json: stated in all four endpoints, r_pred = 0.5 (item wTestPrediction)
declared.liftedSide: r_lift = (w25 + lam25 (1 - w25)) / (w50 + lam50 (1 - w50)) and lam25, read and reported, never gated

rehearsals.r3: W42's 0.5 frames: supported regions 4 / 2 / 3 / 2 (light active, light receded, dark active, dark receded), every one at predicted dr <= 0.094
rehearsals.r1: synthetic LT, 40 seeds a scenario: null PASS in every seed of 64 scenarios (size 0), |r - 0.5| <= 0.069, z <= 0.82 (dr honest); every seed FAILs at r = 0.7 and 1.0; the free-side r is unmoved by lam25 in all 64 checks; the per-pixel mean statistic is not honest (null pass 0.95, z 1.3) and is not declared
rehearsals.r2: two-sided linear control, 40 seeds: free 0.47-0.52 and lifted 0.43-0.50 agree within dr; with the hinge the lifted reading matches its expectation and lam25 is recovered to +-0.02
